content: Integrating monolingual data into NMT can be as easy as copying the target into the source, which already gives some improvement; adding noise makes things even better. We now study ways to make pseudo-sources look more like natural data, using the framework of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) BIBREF27 , an idea borrowed from BIBREF26 .
